description: This file contains a function 'ansi2html' that converts ANSI escape sequences in text to HTML span elements with inline styles, including handling of colors, styles, and text decorations. It also defines color mappings for ANSI colors.

methods.name: ansi2html
methods.description: Converts ANSI escape sequences in input text to HTML span elements with inline styles, applying colors and text styles based on ANSI codes.

methods.name: escapeHTML
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: styleBody
methods.description: Converts a style object to a CSS style string.
